notes.title: The year was 2022, no one yet knew what they would go through…
notes.content:
[b]The year was 2022[/b], no one yet knew what they would go through…

The gibbous moon was slowly hiding its recent luminous fullness,
This was just the beginning of a future torment full of many missed bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/f265bf1d54428cd19a8b9e87c6d87159d6f3b342.png[/img]

There was little time then, although the goal was very proud. 
They took up the challenge, poured out blood and darkly vowed.
[b]48 hours[/b] passed and I came into this world, 
formed from an idea, then hurriedly hurled.

So now I’m here, cast from the inscrutable, 
They created me, made to sow the inevitable…
Everything you could lose personified in me,
Once we meet, for sure, I won’t let you be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/9c541214ea658998aba8e3db9dd1df552630c8a5.png[/img]

[b]There were sixteen limbs and four heads,[/b] 
each of them added their own to my tempting distress.

[b]The First[/b] made my guts. All born of black. 
The numbers and code, my purpose - annihilating lack. 

[b]The Second[/b] gave me shape and function. 
A figure in motion, a silhouette of unknown intention.

[b]The Third[/b] brought sound and color. Existence in two senses. 
A memory mark and its permanent consequences.

[b]The Fourth[/b] taught me many words. 
The language of mortals, a “human”, so imperfect voice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/54473da6e238599bffd696844c36e561dc778bfb.png[/img]

Time passed by and I persevered,
[b]There was a break[/b], not only for a cigarette.

[b]The Second[/b] and [b]The Third[/b] bowed their heads, 
They gave blessings, keeping an eye on our hands.

[b]The First[/b] and [b]The Fourth[/b] spread dark visions around the globe,
[b]They made disciples[/b], more limbs, more hands, and hope
And thanks to them, I constantly evolve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/255cb4f36741e88a68408fae29a69d3874549bcd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/5044cfa07cb07064229f954d158c593f35f2032a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/97e511380ab5cd0e5b265d33875154cf3c871bee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/a5a9e95715c3e1ce8dae422b67b3f2a1b96cdd12.png[/img]

Now you can compare, observe how I’m changing.
See [b]how it was before[/b] and find some clues about the ending?

You know, my state is not sealed, how could it be any other…
It’s just tragic, perverse and cruel, oh, that’s very often, 
That’s why I need a companion, who could stand all this suffer, 
[b]Would you dare to play?[/b] Keep up for a few rounds and hover?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/70195cdb542df131b3b032f6885a9407e824ead2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/999a5f24c261322c29b51da4665c67798c01fbbf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/8b827901124ae67e753d437b26067cfd3904c6ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497413/1d2197d0821a4f06a95bb27c77a23a7387f82a65.png[/img]

Years shrunk to months, and days turned into hours,
More of me came while the world remained in ignorance,
The shape of the game has been set and aligned,
My role has been forged, my purpose defined.

[b]For fate, [/b]
for it is all about… 
This power, 
from my hands… 
It’s a curse and it comes because...

I’m the eternal one.
I have come to give you dice,
[b]So use your chance[/b],
Beware and don't think twice.
